rule.memory: Early cap exit is original reason=time with explicit diagnostic early flag, so bear BELOW can enable original future BODY/ACF recovery. Altered exits change subsequent opportunities and fills; no deletion-of-later-loss causal arithmetic
rule.timing: Own original signal-entry T age0; T+1 age1; T+2 age2 produces TIME exit; earliest execution T+3. EX073 later two-day label begins O[T+3]. Signal-age deadline is not guaranteed actual holding days when native limit buy delays/fails
